log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Present a dependency audit so readers can identify packages and assess their versions, licenses, vulnerabilities, and notes.","tasks":["Find a package and read across its audit record.","Scan vulnerability and license values across packages.","Check version identifiers and explanatory notes."],"relations":["Each row describes one package; its version, license, vulnerability status, and notes belong together.","The long internal package name is an identifier, while notes provide supporting context."],"roles":["The header names five fields; package names serve as the practical row identifiers even though no row headers are declared.","Version, license, and vulnerability columns contain compact lookup values; notes carry longer explanatory text."],"keep_whole":["Package identifiers, especially the scoped internal package name, when space permits.","Version identifiers, license names, vulnerability counts and their severity qualifiers.","Column headers, especially Vulnerabilities."],"may_wrap":["Notes prose at word boundaries.","Package names at meaningful separators when necessary, though the long scoped name may require an arbitrary split in a fitted layout."],"same_scale":["Version and license are compact reference fields; vulnerability status needs slightly more room for its header and severity qualifier.","Package and notes deserve more width than the compact fields, according to their different identifier and prose content."],"h_vs_v":"A fitted table keeps all fields visible together but forces breaks in long identifiers and notes. A wider table preserves semantic units and reduces row height, at the cost of horizontal scrolling and potentially hiding notes on first sight."},"designs":[{"widths":[200,112,98,124,185],"strategy":"Fit all five fields within 719px, prioritizing compact audit fields and accepting breaks in the longest package identifier and notes."},{"widths":[412,112,98,124,273],"strategy":"Use horizontal scrolling to keep every package identifier whole and give notes enough width for their longest unbreakable unit."},{"widths":[260,112,98,124,489],"strategy":"Favor fully expanded notes in a scrolling table while allowing the longest package name to wrap."}]}
